[Dolangmal]
Hey~! Hi human~ This is Mr. Dolangmal. kakaka~

[Dolangmal]
We are sent to here to take you to the heaven of cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000.
[Dolangmal]

[Dolangmal]
How is that? The crowded city of Prontera is good, but why don't you go our heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?

[Dolangmal]
Why don't you go to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000? That place is better than Geffen, where there are only crowds of simple honest wizards.

[Dolangmal]
The fresh air of Payon is not bad, but why don't you go better place like the heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?

[Dolangmal]
{0}The beautiful and quiet place is better than Aldebaran, where it's so noisy with the tick-tock sound of the clock.

[Dolangmal]
{0}The beautiful and quiet place is better than Morocc, with its heat and sandstorms.

[Dolangmal]
{0}The beautiful place is better than Juno, which is full of books and headaches.

[Dolangmal]
{0}The complex place is better than Rachel, where it's too horribly quiet.

[Dolangmal]
{0}The safe place is better than Lighthalzen, which is too dangerous.

[Dolangmal]
{0}The smell of this sea place is better than Mora, which is full of a grassy smell.
No
^A2314BMalangdo^000000~ Go~ Go~

[Dolangmal]
What!? You don't want to go ^A2314BMalangdo^000000? Chet!

[Dolangmal]
You're such an annoying guy. If you don't go, why did you talk to me... but...

[Dolangmal]
^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 said to kidnap humans... No... Bring them politely?

[Dolangmal]
Anyway, I got you. Whenever you want to go, just tell me.

[Dolangmal]
Ok! I like your attitude. Full of passion.

[Dolangmal]
Now, before you go ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, let me give you some warnings.

[Dolangmal]
First!! It is natural that when you arrive on ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, you should notify ^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 that you are here.

[Dolangmal]
If you don't do that, you might be attacked by scary and wild cats when you walk through dark streets.

[Dolangmal]
Secondly!! This ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 is absolutely our island of cats, even though we open to humans.

[Dolangmal]
We have a personality... no... no... respect us like one catality because we are cats.

[Dolangmal]
And the next one is...
Dolangmal proceeds and gives hundreds of warnings.

[Dolangmal]
Ok! Those are all the warnings!! They're easy and simple... right? Can you remember them?
Remember his warnings
Can't remember

[Dolangmal]
Ok! Do not bite two mice with one mouth. ^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 is located at the ^A2314Bcenter of the ship in Malangdo^000000.

[Dolangmal]
Don't forget to give him notice of your arrival.

[Dolangmal]
Alright. Let's go to the heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000~

[Dolangmal]
What!? Can't you keep these easy rules? Chet!

[Dolangmal]
You're such an annoying guy. If you can't keep these, why didn't you tell me during our conversation? I told you everything... but..

[Dolangmal]
^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 said to kidnap humans... No... Bring them politely?

[Dolangmal]
Anyway, I got you. Just tell me whenever you want to go.

[Dolangmal]
Uh? You must be the one from last time...? Alright. Did you visit ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?
Take me to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 again
I have visited

[Dolangmal]
I really want to send you there, but I can't because of the policy. It is difficult to send people who have visited ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 already.

[Dolangmal]
And that was roughly it... It's supposed to be rule 53...

[Dolangmal]
Actually, let me tell you rule 53. I am an indulgent cat.

[Dolangmal]
If you want to go back to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, take the ship at Izlude or Alberta.

[Dolangmal]
If you enjoy that pleasant sea trip, you will arrive at the heaven of cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000.

[Dolangmal]
So easy! Isn't it? Well, good bye~

[Dolangmal]
How was it? You liked it? I knew it. Kakaka~

[Dolangmal]
Ah! I just want to make sure...

[Dolangmal]
Again, if you want to go back to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, do you know where to take a ship at Izlude or Alberta?

[Dolangmal]
Hm~ You might know because you're a smart person. Well, see you again~
